input.query: Rust library crates should use thiserror and binaries should use anyhow for error handling

memories.content: In Rust projects, the user requires library crates to define error types using thiserror, and binary crates to use anyhow for error handling, never the reverse.

The user has been bitten twice by Rust crates using the wrong error-handling library for their crate type (e.g. a library crate using anyhow instead of thiserror, or vice versa for a binary), which motivates a strict thiserror-in-libs/anyhow-in-bins rule.
